Barbarian — Brutality.description: A headlong melee fighter built around brutal weapon strikes and momentum. Commit to close range and shape the tree around your preferred attack chains.
Barbarian — Brutality.focus: A headlong melee fighter built around brutal weapon strikes and momentum.

Barbarian — Headhunting.description: Take the hunt to medium range with axes, spears and bleeding wounds. A weapon-focused alternative to standing back and casting spells.
Barbarian — Headhunting.focus: Take the hunt to medium range with axes, spears and bleeding wounds.

Barbarian — Ancestry.description: Bring kegs, ancestral power and a fighter’s presence to the group. This tree mixes a brawling identity with tools that help the party.
Barbarian — Ancestry.focus: Bring kegs, ancestral power and a fighter’s presence to the group.

Bloodmage — Sanguine.description: Shape a blood-magic toolkit around vampiric attacks and supernatural power. Explore how the tree’s strikes and spell effects reinforce one another.
Bloodmage — Sanguine.focus: Shape a blood-magic toolkit around vampiric attacks and supernatural power.

Bloodmage — Accursed.comparison: Feral Druid with a worgen curse
Bloodmage — Accursed.description: Lean into the curse and fight through fangs, reaving attacks and a transformed identity. The kit centers on predatory close-range pressure.
Bloodmage — Accursed.focus: Lean into the curse and fight through fangs, reaving attacks and a transformed identity.

Bloodmage — Eternal.comparison: Blood Death Knight meets Guardian Druid
Bloodmage — Eternal.description: Build a durable frontline around thick hide, blood magic and a relentless hunt. The fantasy is a cursed protector that stays in the fight.
Bloodmage — Eternal.focus: Build a durable frontline around thick hide, blood magic and a relentless hunt.

Bloodmage — Fleshweaver.description: Work with sanguine essence and flesh-shaping magic rather than traditional holy healing. Read the preserved effects to build the balance of healing and aggression you want.
Bloodmage — Fleshweaver.focus: Work with sanguine essence and flesh-shaping magic rather than traditional holy healing.

Chronomancer — Infinite.description: Tear at time with Timerend, anomalies and reality-warping spells. Build around the interactions between temporal pressure and your chosen finishers.
Chronomancer — Infinite.focus: Tear at time with Timerend, anomalies and reality-warping spells.

Chronomancer — Artificer.description: Turn echoes, wands and temporal artistry into a spellcasting toolkit. A good starting point if you enjoy a magical-engineer interpretation of time magic.
Chronomancer — Artificer.focus: Turn echoes, wands and temporal artistry into a spellcasting toolkit.

Chronomancer — Time.description: Use ripples and the sands of time to mend damage and correct mistakes. The healing fantasy is changing the outcome rather than simply adding more light.
Chronomancer — Time.focus: Use ripples and the sands of time to mend damage and correct mistakes.

Cultist — Godblade.description: Take a voidforged blade into melee and build around eldritch weapon effects. Rifts and abyssal power give the martial kit an Old God identity.
Cultist — Godblade.focus: Take a voidforged blade into melee and build around eldritch weapon effects.

Cultist — Corruption.description: Spread corruption and feed a growing web of dark effects. This tree favors the fantasy of wearing enemies down with forbidden magic.
Cultist — Corruption.focus: Spread corruption and feed a growing web of dark effects.

Cultist — Heretic.description: Combine malevolence, shadow weapons and forbidden rites in an unconventional hybrid toolkit. Inspect each talent to decide which supporting interactions anchor your build.
Cultist — Heretic.focus: Combine malevolence, shadow weapons and forbidden rites in an unconventional hybrid toolkit.

Cultist — Dreadnought.comparison: Protection Warrior with Old God armor
Cultist — Dreadnought.description: Carry a shield into the void and become an armored eldritch bulwark. Defensive choices sit alongside shield attacks and Old God boons.
Cultist — Dreadnought.focus: Carry a shield into the void and become an armored eldritch bulwark.

Felsworn — Slayer.description: Fight up close with demonic assaults, blades and an immolation aura. A fast, aggressive starting point for players who like a fel-powered melee identity.
Felsworn — Slayer.focus: Fight up close with demonic assaults, blades and an immolation aura.

Felsworn — Infernal.comparison: Destruction Warlock with a fel battlemage feel
Felsworn — Infernal.description: Build around ruin, chaos and the power of Sargeras. This is the spellcasting side of the Felsworn, with talent choices that reshape its destructive toolkit.
Felsworn — Infernal.focus: Build around ruin, chaos and the power of Sargeras.

Felsworn — Tyrant.description: Bring demonic will and carving attacks to the front line. The tree offers a durable fel-warrior fantasy rather than the Slayer’s pure aggression.
Felsworn — Tyrant.focus: Bring demonic will and carving attacks to the front line.

Guardian — Vanguard.description: A traditional shield-bearing defender built around heavy blows and iron resolve. Start here if you enjoy a clear frontline protector identity.
Guardian — Vanguard.focus: A traditional shield-bearing defender built around heavy blows and iron resolve.

Guardian — Inspiration.comparison: A battlefield captain and group buffer
Guardian — Inspiration.description: Lead from the battlefield with inspiring abilities and coordinated strength. Your kit’s identity is making the group stronger through a martial support role.
Guardian — Inspiration.focus: Lead from the battlefield with inspiring abilities and coordinated strength.

Guardian — Gladiator.comparison: Arms Warrior with a duelist identity
Guardian — Gladiator.description: Trade the pure defensive focus for sword training and decisive melee attacks. Shape a disciplined weapon fighter around the preserved Gladiator talents.
Guardian — Gladiator.focus: Trade the pure defensive focus for sword training and decisive melee attacks.

Knight of Xoroth — War.comparison: Arms Warrior with demonic weapon magic
Knight of Xoroth — War.description: Combine warlike weapon strikes with Xoroth’s demonic flavor. Gore, mutilation and martial aggression define the tree’s starting toolkit.
Knight of Xoroth — War.focus: Combine warlike weapon strikes with Xoroth’s demonic flavor.

Knight of Xoroth — Hellfire.description: Bring hellfire into a knight’s toolkit through burning blades and demonic invasion. Build around the relationships between your fire effects and chosen attacks.
Knight of Xoroth — Hellfire.focus: Bring hellfire into a knight’s toolkit through burning blades and demonic invasion.

Knight of Xoroth — Defiance.comparison: Protection Paladin with an imp entourage
Knight of Xoroth — Defiance.description: Anchor the front line with a shield and a distinctly demonic supporting cast. Imp-related talents add a different texture to a defensive knight.
Knight of Xoroth — Defiance.focus: Anchor the front line with a shield and a distinctly demonic supporting cast.

Necromancer — Death.description: Work with rot, worms and the cycle of death to pressure enemies. A decay-centered caster fantasy for players who enjoy dark spell interactions.
Necromancer — Death.focus: Work with rot, worms and the cycle of death to pressure enemies.

Necromancer — Rime.description: Build around ice barrages, icicles and biting cold. This is the Necromancer’s frozen spellcasting path, with a colder identity than rot or minions.
Necromancer — Rime.focus: Build around ice barrages, icicles and biting cold.

Necromancer — Animation.description: Raise an undead force and invest in the talents that strengthen your summons. The core fantasy is directing a growing army rather than fighting alone.
Necromancer — Animation.focus: Raise an undead force and invest in the talents that strengthen your summons.

Primalist — Grovekeeper.description: Use life magic, spiritual charge and the earth’s power to support allies. The archived tree calls this path Life; the roster calls it Grovekeeper.
Primalist — Grovekeeper.focus: Use life magic, spiritual charge and the earth’s power to support allies.

Primalist — Geomancy.description: Call on tremors, stone and Therazane’s power. Build an earth-focused caster whose identity is grounded in seismic effects rather than fire or lightning.
Primalist — Geomancy.focus: Call on tremors, stone and Therazane’s power.

Primalist — Wildwalker.description: Take primal bites, totemic strikes and the fury of the wild into melee. The archived tree labels this path Primal.
Primalist — Wildwalker.focus: Take primal bites, totemic strikes and the fury of the wild into melee.

Primalist — Mountain King.description: Stand firm with stone, seismic force and an unyielding form. A defensive interpretation of primal power built for the front line.
Primalist — Mountain King.focus: Stand firm with stone, seismic force and an unyielding form.

Pyromancer — Flameweaving.description: Turn cleansing and soothing flames into a healing toolkit. Phoenix abilities give this path a restorative fire identity.
Pyromancer — Flameweaving.focus: Turn cleansing and soothing flames into a healing toolkit.

Pyromancer — Incineration.description: Lean into ignite, combustion and concentrated fire magic. Build your tree around the burning interactions you want to emphasize.
Pyromancer — Incineration.focus: Lean into ignite, combustion and concentrated fire magic.

Pyromancer — Draconic.description: Draw on the dragon aspects and their different gifts. Explore how draconic blessings and fire effects combine in a supporting toolkit.
Pyromancer — Draconic.focus: Draw on the dragon aspects and their different gifts.

Ranger — Archery.description: Focus on precise shots, arrows and ranged weapon pressure. A direct starting point for players who want the bow itself to be the center of the kit.
Ranger — Archery.focus: Focus on precise shots, arrows and ranged weapon pressure.

Ranger — Farstrider.comparison: A scouting archer with group utility
Ranger — Farstrider.description: Mix falcon-themed attacks, cunning and battlefield calls. This path puts a supportive ranger identity alongside its ranged weapon skills.
Ranger — Farstrider.focus: Mix falcon-themed attacks, cunning and battlefield calls.

Ranger — Brigand.comparison: Rogue with a rougher brawler feel
Ranger — Brigand.description: Fight dirty with ravaging attacks, knuckledusters and jagged cuts. The Brigand is a close-range interpretation of the Ranger.
Ranger — Brigand.focus: Fight dirty with ravaging attacks, knuckledusters and jagged cuts.

Reaper — Harvest.comparison: Unholy Death Knight with a harvesting weapon
Reaper — Harvest.description: Build around doom-rending attacks and the harvest of death. A dark melee path with a strong scythe-and-grave fantasy.
Reaper — Harvest.focus: Build around doom-rending attacks and the harvest of death.

Reaper — Soul.description: Use soulforged weaponry, marks and a death-chasing toolkit. Explore the connections between your weapon attacks and spectral effects.
Reaper — Soul.focus: Use soulforged weaponry, marks and a death-chasing toolkit.

Reaper — Domination.description: Claim the front line through dread, fortitude and soul-taking power. This is the Reaper’s defensive path.
Reaper — Domination.focus: Claim the front line through dread, fortitude and soul-taking power.

Runemaster — Engravement.description: Fight through runic brands and magical weapon interactions. The archived tree calls this path Runic; the roster calls it Engravement.
Runemaster — Engravement.focus: Fight through runic brands and magical weapon interactions.

Runemaster — Glyphic.description: Assemble a spellcasting toolkit from glyphs, crystals and arcane effects. The archived tree uses the name Arcane for this path.
Runemaster — Glyphic.focus: Assemble a spellcasting toolkit from glyphs, crystals and arcane effects.

Runemaster — Riftblade.description: Blend smoldering attacks, runic omens and unbound energy. Build a melee toolkit with a strong magical edge.
Runemaster — Riftblade.focus: Blend smoldering attacks, runic omens and unbound energy.

Starcaller — Moon Guard.description: Guard the party beneath a blanket of stars and a lunar shield of effects. This path turns the Starcaller’s celestial identity toward frontline defense.
Starcaller — Moon Guard.focus: Guard the party beneath a blanket of stars and a lunar shield of effects.

Starcaller — Moon Priest.comparison: Holy Priest with Elune’s lunar flavor
Starcaller — Moon Priest.description: Use Elune’s blessings, moonflow and prayers to restore allies. A recognizable healer fantasy expressed through lunar magic.
Starcaller — Moon Priest.focus: Use Elune’s blessings, moonflow and prayers to restore allies.

Starcaller — Sentinel.description: Channel Elune’s power through starfire shots and a celestial bow toolkit. This is the ranged-weapon side of the Starcaller.
Starcaller — Sentinel.focus: Channel Elune’s power through starfire shots and a celestial bow toolkit.

Starcaller — Warden.description: Use knives, astral blades and relentless pursuit. The Warden combines a mobile assassin fantasy with the Starcaller’s celestial theme.
Starcaller — Warden.focus: Use knives, astral blades and relentless pursuit.

Stormbringer — Lightning.description: Build around lightning, conductivity and Thorim’s power. A storm caster whose spell relationships are centered on electricity.
Stormbringer — Lightning.focus: Build around lightning, conductivity and Thorim’s power.

Stormbringer — Wind.description: Shape the battlefield through tempest calling, flow and elemental bonds. This path offers a supporting storm identity.
Stormbringer — Wind.focus: Shape the battlefield through tempest calling, flow and elemental bonds.

Stormbringer — Maelstrom.description: Harness stormflow and torrential power in a tempest-centered toolkit. Inspect its abilities to plan the movement and casting rhythm you prefer.
Stormbringer — Maelstrom.focus: Harness stormflow and torrential power in a tempest-centered toolkit.

Sun Cleric — Piety.description: Scorch enemies with radiant flame and sun magic. This is the Sun Cleric’s spellcasting damage path.
Sun Cleric — Piety.focus: Scorch enemies with radiant flame and sun magic.

Sun Cleric — Blessings.description: Build a restorative toolkit around blessings and sanctified power. A direct route into the Sun Cleric’s supportive, healing identity.
Sun Cleric — Blessings.focus: Build a restorative toolkit around blessings and sanctified power.

Sun Cleric — Seraphim.description: Take shining shields and royal hammers into the front line. The solar guardian fantasy pairs defensive tools with radiant strikes.
Sun Cleric — Seraphim.focus: Take shining shields and royal hammers into the front line.

Sun Cleric — Valkyrie.comparison: Retribution Paladin with Odyn’s warrior flavor
Sun Cleric — Valkyrie.description: Fight through glorious executions, sunslams and a sun-sworn martial kit. A close-range path with a distinctly heroic solar identity.
Sun Cleric — Valkyrie.focus: Fight through glorious executions, sunslams and a sun-sworn martial kit.

Templar — Oathkeeper.comparison: Brewmaster-style tank with a sacred staff
Templar — Oathkeeper.description: Build a sacred frontline fighter around staff defense and a sworn protector’s toolkit. The weapon-and-oath identity gives it a different feel from a shield tank.
Templar — Oathkeeper.focus: Build a sacred frontline fighter around staff defense and a sworn protector’s toolkit.

Templar — Zealot.description: Press the attack with vindication and righteous upheaval. A determined sacred warrior built around aggressive melee choices.
Templar — Zealot.focus: Press the attack with vindication and righteous upheaval.

Templar — Crusader.comparison: Windwalker Monk with a sacred weapon identity
Templar — Crusader.description: Combine a righteous tempest, an argent blade and focused martial attacks. A mobile-feeling holy fighter fantasy to explore through the tree.
Templar — Crusader.focus: Combine a righteous tempest, an argent blade and focused martial attacks.

Tinker — Demolition.comparison: A ranged engineer and explosives specialist
Tinker — Demolition.description: Bring bombs, rockets and spider-bomb constructs to a fight. Build an explosive toolkit rather than a conventional spellcaster.
Tinker — Demolition.focus: Bring bombs, rockets and spider-bomb constructs to a fight.

Tinker — Invention.description: Keep the group alive with restorative beacons, repairs and field-medic tools. A technical take on healing through invention.
Tinker — Invention.focus: Keep the group alive with restorative beacons, repairs and field-medic tools.

Tinker — Mechanics.description: Operate a mechanical toolkit of cogs, dynamite and a laser-equipped suit. Build around the ranged attacks and machine interactions you want to emphasize.
Tinker — Mechanics.focus: Enter the fight through a mechanical toolkit of cogs, dynamite and a laser-equipped suit.

Venomancer — Rotweaver.comparison: Affliction Warlock with spores and toxins
Venomancer — Rotweaver.description: Build a toxic spellcasting web around wilting effects, spores and fungal growth. The archived tree labels this path Venom.
Venomancer — Rotweaver.focus: Build a toxic spellcasting web around wilting effects, spores and fungal growth.

Venomancer — Stalking.description: Apply withering venom and stalking attacks at close range. A predatory poison-fighter identity rather than a distant caster.
Venomancer — Stalking.focus: Apply withering venom and stalking attacks at close range.

Venomancer — Fortitude.comparison: Guardian Druid with an insectoid carapace
Venomancer — Fortitude.description: Use a reinforced exoskeleton and regenerative carapace to hold the front line. A defensive toolkit expressed through venomous biology.
Venomancer — Fortitude.focus: Use a reinforced exoskeleton and regenerative carapace to hold the front line.

Venomancer — Vizier.description: Mend allies through mycelial healing, mist and alchemical effects. The healer’s toolkit grows out of the Venomancer’s fungal and toxic theme.
Venomancer — Vizier.focus: Mend allies through mycelial healing, mist and alchemical effects.

Witch Doctor — Voodoo.description: Command shadow puppets, Loa spirits and bad juju. The Voodoo path emphasizes the Witch Doctor’s ritual spellcasting identity.
Witch Doctor — Voodoo.focus: Command shadow puppets, Loa spirits and bad juju.

Witch Doctor — Brewing.description: Gather ingredients, mix potions and toss restorative concoctions. A healer built around brewing rather than a traditional spell-school identity.
Witch Doctor — Brewing.focus: Gather ingredients, mix potions and toss restorative concoctions.

Witch Doctor — Shadowhunting.description: Pair malefic arrows with Loa power and shadow-hunting magic. A weapon-driven path for players who like ritual flavor with their ranged attacks.
Witch Doctor — Shadowhunting.focus: Pair malefic arrows with Loa power and shadow-hunting magic.

Witch Hunter — Boltslinger.description: Fire witchbane volleys and heartseeking bolts while developing your crossbow toolkit. An agile ranged identity with shadow-hunting flavor.
Witch Hunter — Boltslinger.focus: Fire witchbane volleys and heartseeking bolts while developing your crossbow toolkit.

Witch Hunter — Houndmaster.comparison: Beast Mastery Hunter with shadow hounds
Witch Hunter — Houndmaster.description: Coordinate ranged attacks with a pack of supernatural hounds. Build around how your own shots and your companions reinforce one another.
Witch Hunter — Houndmaster.focus: Coordinate ranged attacks with a pack of supernatural hounds.

Witch Hunter — Inquisition.description: Bring the hunt into melee with dusk blades, flame sermons and holy judgment. A close-range interpretation of the Witch Hunter.
Witch Hunter — Inquisition.focus: Bring the hunt into melee with dusk blades, flame sermons and holy judgment.

Witch Hunter — Black Knight.comparison: Blood Death Knight with a cursed duelist feel
Witch Hunter — Black Knight.description: Hold the front line through shadow brands, dark chivalry and cursed weapon attacks. The kit presents a defensive knight with a strong shadow identity.
Witch Hunter — Black Knight.focus: Hold the front line through shadow brands, dark chivalry and cursed weapon attacks.
